forum.title: About the control connector of IPMM15B
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome ​@TyrantRenre, to the community!

You can find this information on the [product website of the STEVAL-IPMM15B](https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/steval-ipmm15b.html), for example, in [UM2704](https://www.st.com/resource/en/user_manual/um2704-1500-w-motor-control-power-board-based-on-stib1560dm2tl-sllimm-2nd-series-mosfet-ipm-stmicroelectronics.pdf), fig. 17, or by taking a look at the [GERBER data](https://www.st.com/resource/en/board_manufacturing_specification/steval-ipmm15b_gerber.zip). Since the connector has a notch to prevent reverse polarity, the corresponding 34-pin plug on a ribbon cable usually fits.

Hope that answers your question?

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text:
I am connecting IPMM15B’s J2 to IHM09M2's J7. There are  documents showing how J7 is aligned and where it is situated on the board. But I have no idea how J2 is oriented. The schematic is too brief. It could be opposite aligned if I turned the board around to the inverse side. I don’t know how the pins should be connected.

I need to know where pin1 pin2 is situated on the board.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/67d2b7c1-f185-44a4-a5c7-a0a91a233f96.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/733e8757-ac99-47c9-90c5-8f7ff95ddeb5.png)
